# Week 3 Start/Sit Briefing — Wednesday, 2026-09-23 (fourth version)

## Source and freshness

**Not live for projections.** Built from `weekly-report-week-3.json` as regenerated at 21:08 UTC with the blend fix (`2f04572`) and the injury-source fix (`fc4de02`), FantasyPros consensus and ESPN injuries. Live nflreadpy practice data covers only Atlanta and Green Bay.

**Why there are four versions:** the first was built on projections deflated about 3x. The weekly report never gave the blend model the usage stats it was trained on, so every in-house projection collapsed toward a positional average (JSN was at 6 if he plays). The second used the pre-fix CI report, which still carried that deflation for everyone outside the FantasyPros tier. The third used a report with the blend fixed but injuries dropped: nflreadpy's partial week-3 report (ATL/GB only) overrode ESPN for every team, so Dart read 0.696 to play. Same lineup; this one has the right probabilities.

## Practice report

No rostered player is on any Week 3 report yet; only ATL and GB have filed. London and Golden are absent from those two reports, meaning no concern was listed.

| Player | Designation | Source | P(play) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Jaxson Dart | **Out for the season**: knee surgery | ESPN via CI | 0.003 |
| Brock Bowers | **Questionable**: knee, meniscus (upgraded from Out) | ESPN via CI | 0.450 |

## Start these ten

| Slot | Player | Opp | Expected | P(play) | If he plays |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Matthew Stafford | @DEN (Sun 8:20pm) | **14.2** | 95.7% | 14.83 |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | vs HOU | **17.71** | 93.2% | 18.99 |
| RB | Bucky Irving | vs MIN | **15.87** | 93.2% | 17.02 |
| WR | Jaxon Smith-Njigba | @WAS | **20.51** | 95.5% | 21.48 |
| WR | Josh Downs | vs HOU | **11.39** | 95.5% | 11.93 |
| TE | Isaiah Likely | vs TEN | **10.45** | 92.6% | 11.29 |
| FLEX | Cam Skattebo | vs TEN | **11.76** | 93.2% | 12.61 |
| FLEX | Tee Higgins | @PIT | **11.03** | 84.2% | 13.09 |
| K | Cameron Dicker | @BUF | **4.16** | 97.9% | 4.25 |
| DEF | Eagles D/ST | @CHI (Mon 8:15pm) | **4.73** | 100.0% | 4.73 |

**Lineup total (expected): 121.81**

**Sit:** Dart (season over — move to IR), Bowers (6.02, Questionable), London (10.82), Golden (10.09), Jameson Williams (9.33).

## Changes since Monday

- **Stafford for Dart.** Dart is expected to need season-ending knee surgery. Move him to IR; that frees a bench spot for a backup QB, which you now need.
- **Downs and Higgins in, Golden and London out.** With usage stats restored, Downs (11.39) and Higgins (11.03) top the WR tier behind JSN. The four are within 1.3 points of each other, so treat the order as soft.
- **Higgins over Williams.** 11.03 against 9.33 expected (13.09 vs 11.07 if they play). Williams has 13 targets and 6.9 points a game this season; Higgins has 16 and 11.7.
- **Likely over Bowers, for now.** 10.45 against 6.02 expected (11.29 vs 13.37 if they play). Bowers is Questionable with no practice data yet; if he practises in full by Friday, he takes the spot.

## Still uncertain

- **Bowers**: LV's Thursday/Friday practice reports decide the TE slot.
- **The WR tier** (Downs, Higgins, London, Golden) is within noise; a practice report or depth-chart change could reorder it.

## Byes ahead

None in Weeks 3–4. Nearest: Dicker, Week 7.
